name: Agentic Workflow Configuration
description: Settings for AI-assisted development with epistemic guardrails and memory persistence
author: Julien GELEE

SessionStart.description: Load persistent memory context at session start

PreResponse.message: Remember to follow CLAUDE.md protocols: check context, create TODO/plan for substantial work, provide checkpoints.

PostError.command: python3 -c "from memory_manager import find_similar_error; import sys; print(find_similar_error(sys.argv[1]))" "${error_message}"
PostError.description: Check memory for known solutions to this error

aliases.checkpoint: Provide a structured checkpoint with Done, In Progress, TODO, and Global Objective sections.
aliases.plan: Create a TODO/Plan with clear steps, dependencies, and vigilance points before starting work.
aliases.reread: Reread the initial request and full conversation context before responding.
aliases.memory-search: Search persistent memory for relevant past context: ${query}
aliases.error-check: Check if this error has been solved before: ${error_message}
